relations.rule: Shows where something happens or is located.

examples.translation: I live in Lisbon.
They stayed at home today.
I work in a hospital.

examples.targetHTML: Nós entramos em uma sala ampla.
examples.translation: We entered a large room.

examples.targetHTML: O café fica em frente à estação.
examples.translation: The cafe is in front of the station.

relations.rule: Places an event in a time period, such as a month or year.

examples.translation: I travel in May.
She was born in 1995.
We will finish in two weeks.
The course starts in September.
They return in a few days.

relations.rule: Shows where someone or something is going.

examples.translation: I am going home.
They travel to Brazil.
She looked toward the sky.
We are returning to the hotel.

examples.targetHTML: O comboio parte para o Porto.
examples.translation: The train departs for Porto.

relations.rule: Links an action to its purpose: what someone wants to do or achieve.
relations.translation: I study in order to learn.

examples.translation: I study in order to learn.
I work in order to support my family.
Called in order to get news.
We stopped in order to rest a bit.

examples.targetHTML: Correu para não perder o autocarro.
examples.translation: Ran in order not to miss the bus.

relations.rule: Shows who something is for.
relations.targetHTML: Isto é um presente para você.
relations.translation: This is a gift for you.

examples.targetHTML: Isto é um presente para você.
examples.translation: This is a gift for you.

examples.targetHTML: Escrevi uma carta para meus pais.
examples.translation: I wrote a letter to my parents.
I cooked dinner for all of us.

examples.targetHTML: Há lugar para mais uma pessoa?
examples.translation: Is there room for one more person?
I left a note for her.

relations.rule: Shows who shares an action or is together with someone.

examples.translation: I speak with you tomorrow.

examples.targetHTML: Fui ao cinema com meus amigos.
examples.translation: I went to the cinema with my friends.
She lives with her sister.
I want to speak with the manager.
We work with excellent professionals.

relations.formulaHTML: com + a tool / way of doing it
relations.rule: Shows the tool used or the way something is done.

examples.translation: I write with care.

examples.targetHTML: Ele abriu a porta com a chave reserva.
examples.translation: He opened the door with the spare key.
We listened to everything with great attention.

examples.targetHTML: Cortei o papel com uma tesoura.
examples.translation: I cut the paper with scissors.

examples.targetHTML: Tratou os convidados com extrema simpatia.
examples.translation: Treated the guests with extreme warmth.

relations.rule: Gives the reason for an action, feeling or result.

examples.translation: Thank you for helping.
I wait for news from you.

examples.targetHTML: Ele foi elogiado por sua coragem.
examples.translation: He was praised for his courage.

examples.targetHTML: Pagou vinte euros por aquele livro.
examples.translation: Paid twenty euros for that book.
I thank you for all the patience.

relations.rule: Shows the route or place someone or something moves through.

examples.translation: I walk around here.
We passed through an old bridge.
Looked through between the railings.

examples.targetHTML: O gato entrou por uma brecha na janela.
examples.translation: The cat entered through a gap in the window.
We traveled through deserted roads.

relations.rule: Combines em + o: “in / on / at the”.
relations.translation: The book is in the room.

examples.translation: The book is in the room.
He is still at work.

examples.targetHTML: Nos encontramos no cinema às oito.
examples.translation: We met at the cinema at eight.

examples.targetHTML: Não há ninguém como ele no mundo.
examples.translation: There is no one like him in the world.
I forgot my wallet in the car.

relations.rule: Combines em + a: “in / on / at the”.

examples.translation: She is at the beach.

examples.targetHTML: A carta está na mesa da sala.
examples.translation: The letter is on the living room table.

examples.targetHTML: Vi muitas pessoas na rua principal.
examples.translation: I saw many people on the main street.

examples.targetHTML: As crianças estão na escola agora.
examples.translation: The children are at school now.
She cooks in the spacious kitchen.

relations.rule: Combines de + o: “of / from the”.
relations.targetHTML: Este é o carro do meu pai.

examples.targetHTML: Este é o carro do meu pai.

examples.targetHTML: A porta do hotel estava fechada.

examples.targetHTML: Gostei muito do final do filme.
examples.translation: I liked the end of the movie a lot.
He came straight from the airport.

examples.targetHTML: A decisão do juiz foi definitiva.
examples.translation: The judge's decision was final.

relations.rule: Combines de + a: “of / from the”.
relations.targetHTML: Esta é a chave da casa.
relations.translation: This is the key to the house.

examples.targetHTML: Esta é a chave da casa.
examples.translation: This is the key to the house.

examples.targetHTML: O sorriso da mãe acalmou a todos.
examples.translation: The mother's smile calmed everyone.

examples.targetHTML: A vista da janela é deslumbrante.
examples.translation: The view from the window is breathtaking.

examples.targetHTML: Conhecemos os cantos da cidade antiga.
examples.translation: We know the corners of the old city.

examples.targetHTML: O ritmo da música empolgou a sala.
examples.translation: The rhythm of the music excited the room.

relations.rule: Compares how something is done with another example.

examples.translation: She sings like a bird.

examples.targetHTML: Ele agiu como um verdadeiro herói.
examples.translation: He acted like a true hero.
Her eyes shine like stars.

examples.targetHTML: Faz as coisas como sempre fez.
examples.translation: Does things like he always did.
Ran fast like the wind.

relations.rule: Shows the role or job someone has in a situation.

examples.translation: I work as an engineer.

examples.targetHTML: Ele atuou como porta-voz do grupo.
examples.translation: He acted as spokesperson for the group.

examples.targetHTML: Ela participou como voluntária no projeto.
examples.translation: She took part as a volunteer in the project.
I speak as a concerned friend.
Was called as chief witness.

relations.rule: Adds a contrasting idea or an unexpected difference.
relations.translation: I tried, but I could not.

examples.translation: I tried, but I could not.

examples.targetHTML: Queria sair, mas estava a chover forte.
examples.translation: I wanted to go out, but it was raining hard.

examples.targetHTML: Ele sabia a resposta, mas ficou calado.
examples.translation: He knew the answer, but stayed silent.

examples.targetHTML: Procurei por todo o lado, mas nada encontrei.
examples.translation: I searched everywhere, but found nothing.

examples.targetHTML: O plano era bom, mas faltou tempo.
examples.translation: The plan was good, but time ran short.

relations.rule: Points to a destination or recipient.

examples.translation: I go to Lisbon tomorrow.

examples.targetHTML: Chegamos a casa são e salvos.
examples.translation: We arrived home safe and sound.
Delivered the document to him.

examples.targetHTML: Escreveu uma nota a um amigo.
examples.translation: Wrote a note to a friend.
They returned to Porto Alegre.

relations.rule: Means “the”. Use the form that matches the noun’s gender and number.

examples.translation: The house is pretty.
The main door was locked.
The city wakes up early.

examples.targetHTML: A noite estava fresca e calma.
examples.translation: The night was cool and quiet.
The trip went very well.

relations.rule: Refers to “her / it”. The surrounding verb and sentence show who or what is meant.

examples.translation: I know her well.

examples.targetHTML: Eu a vi ontem à tarde.
examples.translation: I saw her yesterday afternoon.

examples.targetHTML: Todos a respeitam pelo trabalho sério.
examples.translation: Everyone respects her for her earnest work.

examples.targetHTML: Nunca mais a encontrei depois disso.
examples.translation: I never met her again after that.

examples.targetHTML: O médico a examinou com cuidado.
examples.translation: The doctor examined her carefully.

relations.formulaHTML: an item / idea + e + an item / idea
relations.rule: Joins items, ideas or actions.

examples.translation: I bought bread and cheese.

examples.targetHTML: Ele levantou-se e abriu a janela.
examples.translation: He stood up and opened the window.

examples.targetHTML: Trabalho de dia e estudo à noite.
examples.translation: I work during the day and study at night.

examples.targetHTML: Ela sorriu e agradeceu a ajuda.
examples.translation: She smiled and thanked for the help.

examples.targetHTML: Comemos fruta e bebemos sumo fresco.
examples.translation: We ate fruit and drank fresh juice.

relations.rule: Means “I”. Names who does the action; the pronoun can often be left out.

examples.translation: I live here.

examples.targetHTML: Eu sei exatamente o que fazer.
examples.translation: I know exactly what to do.
I want to talk with you.
I am ready to start.

examples.targetHTML: Eu fiz o melhor que pude.
examples.translation: I did the best that I could.

relations.rule: Means “he / it”. Names who does the action; the pronoun can often be left out.

examples.translation: He works a lot.
He arrived at the agreed time.

examples.targetHTML: Ele sabe o caminho de volta.
examples.translation: He knows the way back.
He said he would come early.
He lives in a world of his own.

relations.rule: Refers to him after a preposition: com ele (with him), para ele (for him).

examples.translation: I spoke with him yesterday.
This is for him.
We cannot decide without him.
Everyone asked for him.
They wrote an article about him.

relations.rule: Means “she / it”. Names who does the action; the pronoun can often be left out.

examples.translation: She knows the answer.
She speaks three languages fluently.
She smiled warmly at us.
She studies medicine in the capital.
She returned from her trip yesterday.

relations.rule: Means “a / an”. Use the form that matches the noun’s gender and number.

examples.translation: I have a brother.
I met a cool friend.
We had a coffee together.
I read a fantastic book.
We looked for a quiet place.

relations.rule: Means “a / an”. Use the form that matches the noun’s gender and number.

examples.translation: I saw a photograph.
She had a brilliant idea.
I will stay here for a week.
I want to ask a simple question.
Told us a funny story.

relations.rule: Means “the”. Use the form that matches the noun’s gender and number.
relations.translation: The books are on the table.

examples.translation: The books are on the table.
The days fly by.
My friends arrive soon.
Her eyes were shining.
The cars stopped at the light.

relations.rule: Refers to “them”. The surrounding verb and sentence show who or what is meant.
relations.translation: I saw them at the movies.

examples.translation: I saw them at the movies.
I did not find them at home.

examples.targetHTML: Eu os comprei na feira de manhã.
examples.translation: I bought them at the morning market.

examples.targetHTML: O professor os chamou para conversar.
examples.translation: The teacher called them to talk.
I stored them carefully.

relations.rule: Means “the”. Use the form that matches the noun’s gender and number.

examples.translation: The doors are open.
The garden flowers blossomed.
The people gave a standing ovation.
The streets were illuminated.
I understand your questions well.

relations.rule: Refers to “me / to me”. The surrounding verb and sentence show who or what is meant.

examples.translation: He helped me today.
She invited me for dinner.
Did you hear me well?

examples.targetHTML: Ele me deu um bom conselho.
examples.translation: He gave me good advice.
Let me know when you arrive.

relations.rule: Can mean “myself”, or belong with a verb, such as lembrar-se (remember). These examples use the after-verb form.

examples.translation: I remember everything.

examples.targetHTML: Sinto-me ótimo depois do descanso.
examples.translation: I feel great after resting.

examples.targetHTML: Sentei-me no banco da praça.
examples.translation: I sat down on the square bench.

examples.targetHTML: Esqueci-me da carteira em casa.
examples.translation: I forgot my wallet at home.
I got up at daybreak.

relations.rule: Refers to “you / to you”. The surrounding verb and sentence show who or what is meant.

examples.translation: I love you.

examples.targetHTML: Eu te vi ontem à tarde.
examples.translation: I saw you yesterday afternoon.
I will call you later.
I will tell you some news.
We wait for you in the lobby.

relations.rule: Refers to “to him / her / you”. The surrounding verb and sentence show who or what is meant.

examples.translation: I gave him the book.
She told him the truth.

examples.targetHTML: O carteiro lhe entregou a encomenda.
examples.translation: The mail carrier delivered the package to her.

examples.targetHTML: Eu lhe enviei uma mensagem ontem.
examples.translation: I sent him a message yesterday.

examples.targetHTML: Lhe desejo toda a sorte do mundo.
examples.translation: I wish you all the luck in the world.

relations.rule: Combines a + o: “to / at the”.
relations.translation: I am going to the market.

examples.translation: I am going to the market.

examples.targetHTML: Fomos ao cinema ver a estreia.
examples.translation: We went to the cinema to see the premiere.
Returned to work on Monday.
We reached the end of the journey.
Looked around with curiosity.

relations.rule: Means “when” doing something; followed by the infinitive (dictionary form).

examples.translation: Upon arriving, let me know.

examples.targetHTML: Ao ouvir o sinal, todos saíram.
examples.translation: Upon hearing the signal, everyone left.

examples.targetHTML: Ao abrir a porta, sentiu o vento frio.
examples.translation: Upon opening the door, felt the cold wind.

examples.targetHTML: Sorriu ao ver os velhos amigos.
examples.translation: Smiled upon seeing the old friends.

examples.targetHTML: Ao entrar na sala, percebeu o silêncio.
examples.translation: Upon entering the room, noticed the silence.

relations.rule: Combines a + a: “to / at the”.

examples.translation: We arrived at night.
We went to the beach to sunbathe.

examples.targetHTML: As crianças foram à escola de manhã.
examples.translation: The kids went to school in the morning.

examples.targetHTML: O filme começa à uma da tarde.
examples.translation: The film begins at one in the afternoon.
We will return to our usual routine.

relations.rule: Combines por + o: “through / by / for the”.

examples.translation: I walked through the park.
Thank you for the constant support.
We passed through the shortest path.
Was recognized for the good work.
Traveled throughout the whole world.

relations.rule: Combines por + a: “through / by / for the”.

examples.translation: Thank you for the help.
We strolled through the old city.
Looked through the bedroom window.
Walks in the very early morning.
Fought for justice with determination.

relations.rule: Combines em + um: “in / on / at a”.

examples.translation: I live in an apartment.
Everything happened in a second.
On a rainy day, we stayed reading.
They live in a quiet place.
We met at a cultural event.

relations.rule: Combines em + uma: “in / on / at a”.

examples.translation: I entered a shop.
We stayed hosted at an inn.

examples.targetHTML: Numa noite fria, acendemos a lareira.
examples.translation: On a cold night, we lit the fireplace.

examples.targetHTML: Ela trabalha numa empresa de tecnologia.
examples.translation: She works at a technology company.

examples.targetHTML: Sentamo-nos numa mesa perto da janela.
examples.translation: We sat at a table near the window.

relations.rule: Shows who something belongs to: “his / of him”.

examples.translation: I know his friend.

examples.targetHTML: A casa dele é muito acolhedora.
examples.translation: His house is very cozy.
I really liked his idea.

examples.targetHTML: O carro dele está parado ali.
examples.translation: His car is parked there.

examples.targetHTML: O trabalho dele foi elogiado por todos.
examples.translation: His work was praised by all.

relations.rule: Shows who something belongs to: “hers / of her”.

examples.translation: Her house is big.

examples.targetHTML: A voz dela é calma e bonita.
examples.translation: Her voice is calm and beautiful.
I respect her opinion a lot.
Her sister arrives tomorrow.

examples.targetHTML: O sorriso dela iluminou o ambiente.
examples.translation: Her smile lit up the room.

relations.rule: Shows what is missing or absent.

examples.translation: Coffee without sugar, please.
He spoke without any hesitation.
We left without any rush.

examples.targetHTML: Isso é, sem dúvida, a melhor opção.
examples.translation: That is, without doubt, the best option.
We solved the issue without problems.

relations.rule: Introduces the topic someone talks or thinks about.

examples.translation: We talked about the project.

examples.targetHTML: Li um livro sobre história europeia.
examples.translation: I read a book about European history.

examples.targetHTML: Eles discutiram sobre o futuro do trabalho.
examples.translation: They discussed about the future of work.

examples.targetHTML: Gostaria de saber mais sobre isso.
examples.translation: I would like to know more about that.

examples.targetHTML: Escreveu um ensaio sobre a arte moderna.
examples.translation: Wrote an essay about modern art.

relations.rule: Shows that something is on or above a surface.
relations.targetHTML: O papel está sobre a mesa.
relations.translation: The paper is on the table.

examples.targetHTML: O papel está sobre a mesa.
examples.translation: The paper is on the table.

examples.targetHTML: A ponte ergue-se sobre o grande rio.
examples.translation: The bridge rises over the great river.

examples.targetHTML: Deixou o casaco sobre a cama.
examples.translation: Left the coat upon the bed.

examples.targetHTML: As chaves ficaram sobre o balcão.
examples.translation: The keys were left on the counter.

examples.targetHTML: O sol poente brilhava sobre a cidade.
examples.translation: The setting sun shone over the city.

relations.rule: Shows where a movement ends or how long something lasts.
relations.translation: I will walk as far as the corner.

examples.translation: I will walk as far as the corner.

examples.targetHTML: Ficamos no evento até às dez.
examples.translation: We stayed at the event until ten.
Wait here until I return.

examples.targetHTML: Trabalhou sem parar até ao anoitecer.
examples.translation: Worked non-stop until nightfall.
They drove as far as the border.

relations.rule: Includes an example that may be surprising.

examples.translation: Even the children understood.

examples.targetHTML: Até ele ficou surpreso com o resultado.
examples.translation: Even he was surprised with the result.

examples.targetHTML: Até os especialistas erraram a previsão.
examples.translation: Even the experts missed the prediction.

examples.targetHTML: Estava tão frio que até a água congelou.
examples.translation: It was so cold that even the water froze.

examples.targetHTML: Até o vento parecia sussurrar segredos.
examples.translation: Even the wind seemed to whisper secrets.

relations.rule: Gives the reason why something happens.
relations.translation: I stayed home because it rained.

examples.translation: I stayed home because it rained.

examples.targetHTML: Não fui à festa porque estava muito cansado.
examples.translation: I didn't go to the party because I was very tired.

examples.targetHTML: Estudo português porque amo a cultura.
examples.translation: I study Portuguese because I love the culture.

examples.targetHTML: Ele sorriu porque ouviu uma boa notícia.
examples.translation: He smiled because he heard good news.

examples.targetHTML: Perguntei porque queria ter a certeza.
examples.translation: I asked because I wanted to be sure.

relations.rule: Connects an event to the time or situation when it happens.

examples.translation: When I arrived, everyone applauded.

examples.targetHTML: Quando você puder, ligue-me por favor.
examples.translation: When you can, please call me.

examples.targetHTML: Quando o sol nasce, a cidade ganha vida.
examples.translation: When the sun rises, the city comes alive.
When you finish the work, let me know.
When I was young, I used to travel a lot.

relations.rule: Refers to an idea, situation or thing already mentioned or near the listener.

examples.translation: That is true.
That happens frequently.
That makes no sense at all.
That changed the whole situation.

examples.targetHTML: Já sabia disso antes de falarem.
examples.translation: I already knew about that before they spoke.

relations.rule: Refers to a thing or idea close to the speaker or being introduced now.

examples.translation: This is for you.
This looks delicious.
This belongs to my colleague.
This is enough for today.

examples.targetHTML: Isto custou muito menos do que imaginei.
examples.translation: This cost much less than I imagined.

relations.rule: Refers to everything in the situation.

examples.translation: Everything is fine.
Everything went perfectly at the event.
Everything changed after that day.
I understood everything that you explained.

examples.targetHTML: Tudo ficou calmo após a tempestade.
examples.translation: Everything became quiet after the storm.
